# pyckup

> Tools to provide easy access to prepared data to data scientists that can't be asked.

- [pyckup.sources](pyckup.sources.html.md): Data sources
- [pyckup.sources.owid](pyckup.sources.owid.html.md): OWID data source.
- [pyckup.util](pyckup.util.html.md): Utils for pyckyp
